long_biography.plain_text:
In 1978, Cheryl and Dan Stabbert established a family company around commercial vessels. Dan brought shipboard experience rooted in his father's maritime work, while Cheryl became an owner from the venture's beginning. Over time, the enterprise added specialized ships and industrial facilities supporting researchers, energy projects and working craft across North America.

A major expansion arrived in 2023 with the purchase of Lovric Sea-Craft on Washington's Guemes Channel. The acquired yard, renamed Guemes Channel Marina, complemented the firm's existing Seattle repair base. Its work emphasizes maintenance, refits and special-purpose conversions rather than new construction. Cheryl is a co-founder and co-owner, while Dan serves as president and chief executive.
